# Abeó Health

> Abeó Health is a care coordination network in South Orange County, California.
> One trusted team coordinates vetted home care, non-emergency medical
> transportation, senior placement, and a family dashboard — so families never
> navigate care alone. Tagline: "Care, coordinated. Because health is everything."
> Philosophy: High Tech, High Touch — technology enables efficiency, but people
> deliver trust.

## What Abeó Health is

Abeó Health, LLC is a care coordination network serving families in South Orange
County, California (Laguna Niguel / Laguna Hills / Saddleback area). It connects
several kinds of care into one coordinated experience run by human coordinators,
rather than offering them as disconnected, self-managed services.

- Entity: Abeó Health, LLC
- Region served: Orange County, California
- Address: 28100 Cabot Rd. Suite 232, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677
- Phone: (949) 987-4605
- Email: info@abeo.health
- Website: https://abeo.health

## Services

- **Abeó Care (home care):** Non-medical, in-home care delivered by W-2 caregivers
  Abeó hires, trains, insures, and stands behind. Abeó Care is a
  California-licensed Home Care Organization (CDSS license HCS 281); all Home Care
  Aides are registered on the California Home Care Aide Registry (HCAR).
  Includes personal care (bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility/transfer
  assistance), companionship, meal preparation, medication reminders
  (non-administration), light housekeeping, laundry, and errands. Note: this is
  non-medical home care, not clinical/skilled nursing. Published rates start at
  $36/hr (Companion tier). Details: https://abeo.health/services/registry

- **Abeó Transport (medical transportation):** Non-emergency medical
  transportation (NEMT) for appointments, hospital discharges, and post-procedure
  pickups. Powered by Uber Health with human, door-to-door coordination and
  wheelchair-accessible options. Details: https://abeo.health/services/ride
  Booking: https://abeo.health/book-ride

- **Senior Placement (part of Abeó Connect):** Free, conflict-disclosed guidance
  to help families find the right assisted living, memory care, or skilled nursing
  community. Paid by the receiving community, not the family.
  Details: https://abeo.health/services/living

- **Abeó Connect (care coordination + family dashboard):** The coordination layer
  that ties everything together — a dedicated human coordinator, a family
  dashboard, real-time communication between family/caregivers/providers, and
  escalation handling. Offered as a monthly subscription (Care Circle
  Coordination). Details: https://abeo.health/services/circle

## Who it serves

Families in Orange County, California arranging care for aging or recovering
loved ones — especially around hospital discharge, post-procedure recovery, and
the transition between hospital and home.

## Coming later (not yet available)

Clinical home health tiers (RN / LVN / PT / OT) are planned for a later phase
(Phase 3) and are shown on the site as a waitlist / "coming soon," not as
currently available services.

## Key facts

- Non-medical home care caregivers are W-2 employees (not independent
  contractors): background-checked (DOJ/FBI), HCAR-registered, CPR/First-Aid
  certified, insured, and covered by workers' compensation.
- Abeó Care operates under California CDSS licensing HCS 281 and the Home Care
  Services Consumer Protection Act.
- Pricing for home care is published and transparent; coordination and clinical
  offerings are quoted per family.
